clientSpotlights.headline: Building Tomorrow, Together: Hear from Nasdaq’s Global Partners

videos.title: Goldman Sachs Asset Management
videos.description: Discover how Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Nasdaq help investors navigate a crowded ETF market — expanding access to innovation, growth and income through strategies like GPIQ.

videos.title: Invesco
videos.description: From QQQ to the income-generating QQA, explore how Nasdaq and Invesco have partnered to deliver innovation and access to investors across the globe.

videos.title: CME Group
videos.description: Learn how CME Group is democratizing access to the Nasdaq-100 — empowering investors of all types to participate in innovation through cutting-edge futures products.

videos.title: Amova Asset Management

solutions.headline: Our Global Index Solutions
solutions.intro: The Blueprint of Tomorrow is not drafted overnight. With a comprehensive range of indexes that cover various asset classes, sectors, and geographies, Nasdaq Global Indexes architects powerful benchmarks that are in sync with the dynamic market environment.

buildings.label: Nasdaq-100®
buildings.intro: The Nasdaq-100® is a globally recognized index of 100 of the most innovative large-cap companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market®.

bodyLink.text: Discover why the Nasdaq-100 matters—and how it can play a role in your investment strategy

buildings.label: Income Generation & Portfolio Protection
buildings.intro: Success is built on innovation. These index-based strategies are designed to serve specialized roles in investor portfolios such as income generation, risk managed returns, or defined outcomes.

cards.title: Income Generation
cards.body: Income generating strategies prioritize yield from dividends and interest and cater to investors aiming for steady and reliable income streams.

cards.title: Managed Risk
cards.body: Managed risk strategies aim to deliver structured investment solutions with predefined risk and return parameters.

cards.title: Insurance Solutions
cards.body: Volatility target strategies tap into the growth potential of the innovative Nasdaq indexes, designed for today's index-linked annuity market.

buildings.label: Megatrends
buildings.intro: Nasdaq Global Indexes is the architect of visionary indexes that herald new megatrends of technology and innovation. Many of these megatrends that have come to define today’s 21st century economy.

cards.title: AI & Cloud
cards.body: The Nasdaq AI & Cloud indexes track companies building the next generation of artificial intelligence and cloud.

cards.title: Cybersecurity
cards.body: The Nasdaq Cybersecurity indexes track companies at the forefront of digital security and data protection.

cards.title: Semiconductors
cards.body: The Nasdaq Semiconductor indexes are sector-specific benchmarks that tracks the performance of companies in the semiconductor industry.

cards.title: Energy Infrastructure
cards.body: The Nasdaq Energy Infrastructure indexes track the companies powering the 21st century economy.

links.text: Where AI Value Accrued as Software Sold Off

buildings.label: Digital Assets
buildings.intro: Nasdaq Global Indexes is leading the way in providing index solutions in the world of digital assets.

cards.title: Nasdaq CME Crypto Index (NCI)
cards.body: The Nasdaq CME Crypto™ Index (NCI™) provides sophisticated exposure to the evolving digital asset landscape. The index adapts dynamically to represent the maturing crypto market while remaining investable.

cards.title: Nasdaq Blockchain Economy™ Index
cards.body: The Nasdaq Blockchain Economy Index is designed to measure the returns of companies that are committing material resources to developing, researching, supporting, innovating or utilizing blockchain technology for their proprietary use or for use by others.

buildings.label: Private Markets
buildings.intro: As private markets investments become more central to portfolio construction and asset allocation for institutional investors, Nasdaq is meeting the need for robust, representative, and high‑quality benchmarking solutions.

cards.title: Nasdaq Private Capital Indexes
cards.body: Transparent, representative, and robust private capital benchmarks built on Nasdaq eVestment’s institutional-quality private markets data.

cards.title: Nasdaq eVestment Private Fund Universe
cards.body: LP‑verified private fund intelligence for comparison and competitive insight that helps investors evaluate opportunities and stay ahead of trends.

cards.title: Nasdaq eVestment TopQ+
cards.body: A private fund research and analytics platform that empowers institutional investor and consultant due diligence while supporting GP fundraising efforts.

cards.title: Nasdaq eVestment Fund and Deal Benchmarking
cards.body: Benchmark performance against fund and deal datasets to better understand relative results and support informed investment decisions.
